message.content:
Here’s a classic recipe for lasagna:

**Ingredients**

| Category | Item | Quantity |
|----------|------|----------|
| **Meat & Protein** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef and pork) | 1–1½ lb (450–680 g) |
| | Italian sausage (optional, for extra flavor) | ½ lb (225 g) |
| | Eggs (for the béchamel sauce) | 2 large |
| | Parmesan cheese (grated) | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Mozzarella cheese (shredded) | 4 cups (400 g) |
| | Salt | To taste |
| | Black pepper | To taste |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | Pinch |
| **Vegetables & Aromatics** | Onion (finely chopped) | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves (minced) | 3–4 |
| | Fresh basil leaves (chopped) | ¼ cup (10 g) |
| | Fresh oregano leaves (chopped) | ¼ cup (10 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp (30 ml) |
| | Crushed tomatoes (canned) | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Water or broth (for sauce) | 1–2 cups (240–480 ml) |
| **Dairy & Fats** | Butter | 2 Tbsp (30 g) |
| | All‑purpose flour | 2 Tbsp (15 g) |
| | Milk | 2 cups (480 ml) |
| | Heavy cream (optional) | ½ cup (120 ml) |
| **Pasta & Baking** | Lasagna noodles (no‑boil or regular) | 9–12 sheets |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp (15 ml) |
| | Aluminum foil | For covering the dish |
| | Baking dish (9×13 in) | 1 |

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your taste or dietary preferences. Enjoy your lasagna!
